title: Ennamma Kannu
desc: Kaasi, a womaniser, tries to woo Gayatri, a young woman, but she thwarts his advances. However, when her fiancé deserts her on the day of her wedding, Kaasi offers her refuge.

title: Bheeshma
desc: When Bheeshma gets involved with Chaitra, an employee of Bheeshma Organics, he develops an interest in organic farming. Trouble ensues when her company announces a new product that seems to be shady.

title: Siva Manasula Sakthi
desc: Siva and Sakthi lie about their respective jobs when they meet. Once the truth comes out, they decide to take revenge but start developing feelings for each other instead.

title: Bramman
desc: Siva, a movie buff, owns a cinema theatre, which runs into financial trouble. However, his life changes for the better when he meets his childhood friend who is now a famous movie director.

title: Yaaradi Nee Mohini
desc: Vasu, a young man with dreams of starting a business, falls for Keerthi, who is already engaged to his friend Cheenu, creating a love triangle that tests their friendships and emotions.
